messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I’d like to get the total balance of my gift cards and certificates. Also, I want to make a change to my recent reservation—I’m interested in switching it to the cheapest business class round trip available, keeping the same dates. Can you help with both?

content: "message": "I can help with both. To get started, please provide your user ID so I can look up your gift card and certificate balances and locate your reservation. For the change request, please also provide the reservation ID (if you don’t know it, say “I don’t know” and I’ll find your most recent reservation). A couple quick confirmations: 1) Has any part of this trip already been flown? 2) Are you okay with me searching both direct and one‑stop options on the same dates and choosing the cheapest business class? Once I find the best option, I’ll send you the full change details and any price difference for your approval before making any updates."
